text: Twenty videos ago, three teams had three different active-member numbers. This is the honest ending -- not a highlight reel -- of what actually changed, and what's still manual.

What got built is real: nightly extraction from SQL Server through Airflow into Snowflake, dbt staging into one model that defines active member exactly once, tested in CI, surfaced in one Power BI model.

What's still open, named plainly: no alerting beyond CI, no self-service metrics layer outside Power BI and direct SQL, and legacy SQL Server remains the one point of failure no downstream test protects.

This solved the real problem we scoped, and fixed a real bug along the way. It didn't solve production monitoring, self-service access, or the source system's own reliability -- those are named, not hidden.
Brightleaf Fitness now runs on one governed number, built and tested in the open, bugs and all. That's the series.
